summary: Read-only UFS/MCQ host contract validated by the DRV-004 admission boundary, DRV-005/DRV-006 GPT extent admission and the DRV-007 make-check integration with exact-status boundary checks. Criteria assessed by the DRV-002 owner against docs/procedures/drv-002/README.md.

acceptance.criterion: Checks cover DMA/GPT/LUN boundaries, timeouts and rejection of write commands.
acceptance.where: tests/test_ufs_contract.py (exact statuses, GPT suite, source-qualified check); fixture.c; gpt_test.c

acceptance.criterion: Reading encrypted Android userdata is not assumed possible.
Hardware PHY/IOMMU/MCQ compatibility is not claimed without measurements.
acceptance.where: check.py evidence: device_executed, native_qualified, BYH3_qualified, DMA_coherency_qualified all false

limits: Host-test only; no UFS hardware behaviour on Exynos 2400 is established; the phone's real GPT was not examined.
